subject: BIOLOGY
description: ICSE 10th Biology: Transpiration, Photosynthesis, Circulatory, Excretory and Nervous Systems

questions.question: Which apparatus is commonly used to measure the rate of water uptake (transpiration) by a plant shoot?
questions.explanation: Ganong's potometer measures the rate of water uptake, which is proportional to transpiration.

questions.question: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs back to the left atrium of the heart?
questions.explanation: Pulmonary veins are the only veins in the human body carrying oxygen-rich blood.

questions.question: The functional and structural filtration unit of the human kidney is the:
questions.explanation: The nephron is the microscopic structural and functional unit of the kidney.

questions.question: Which hormone regulates the blood glucose level by converting excess glucose to glycogen?
questions.explanation: Insulin secreted by beta cells of Islets of Langerhans promotes glycogenesis to lower blood sugar.

questions.question: Light-dependent reaction (Hill's reaction) of photosynthesis occurs in which part of chloroplast?
questions.explanation: The light reactions take place on the thylakoid membranes (grana) containing chlorophyll.
